prompt.en: Who composed the poem "In Flanders Fields" in 1915?
prompt.fr: Qui a composé le poème « In Flanders Fields » en 1915?

options.en: Lieutenant Colonel John McCrae, a Canadian medical officer.
options.fr: Le lieutenant-colonel John McCrae, médecin militaire canadien.

explanation.en: It was written in 1915 by Lieutenant Colonel John McCrae, a doctor serving with the Canadian forces. People still read it aloud on Remembrance Day.
explanation.fr: Le poème a été écrit en 1915 par le lieutenant-colonel John McCrae, médecin au service des forces canadiennes. On le lit encore à voix haute le jour du Souvenir.

source.quote: Canadian medical officer Lieutenant Colonel John McCrae composed the poem “In Flanders Fields” in 1915

verification.evidence: Canadian medical officer Lieutenant Colonel John McCrae composed the poem “In Flanders Fields” in 1915; it is often recited on Remembrance Day
